name: Forest Vibe
address: 449 Central Ave #102, St. Petersburg, FL 33701, United States
address_source: Google Business Profile (gmaps_detail.js on the live Maps place page) and confirmed independently by ilovetheburg.com's opening coverage, which gives the same 449 Central Avenue address.
phone_source: Google Business Profile phone field, cross-checked via the same live Maps place page twice (discovery pass and detail pass).
has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile shows 'Add website' (no website field set), confirmed via scripts/gmaps_detail.js which reads the website authority link (null). WebSearch for '"Forest Vibe" cafe St. Petersburg FL Instagram' and '"Forest Vibe" "St Pete" cafe website email contact' returned only a local news writeup (ilovetheburg.com) and generic directory/review listings (TripAdvisor, Mapquest, VisitStPeteClearwater); none link to an official Forest Vibe website or domain. No Wix/Squarespace/GoDaddy Sites/WordPress presence found.

social_media.evidence: The ilovetheburg.com article tells readers to follow the cafe on Instagram but does not give a handle, and Google's search results for the business name plus Instagram do not surface a verifiable official account (only unrelated cafes and directory pages). No handle was used anywhere on the site since it could not be verified as this exact business.

email_search_note: Deep search performed: Google Business Profile (no email field shown), two WebSearch passes for the business name plus 'website', 'email', 'contact' and 'Instagram' (only a single local blog post found, ilovetheburg.com/forest-vibe-cafe-st-pete/, which does not list an email or official site). No linktree/beacons found because no verified social profile exists to check a bio link on. Consistent with FORGE-BRIEF's registry pattern for small independent food businesses without a public email.

google_business.hours: Mon-Wed 7:30 AM-8 PM, Thu/Fri later (holiday hours differ), Sat 7:30 AM-10:30 PM, Sun 10 AM-8 PM (live Google Business Profile hours, gmaps_detail.js).
google_business.opened: May (per ilovetheburg.com's opening coverage, 'Now open, Forest Vibe is a magical, nature-filled cafe in the middle of Downtown St. Pete').

services_source: Real menu items and prices read directly off photographed pastry-case price tags (output/forestvibestpete/assets/raw/gmaps-3.jpg and gmaps-4.jpg), downloaded from the business's own Google Maps photo gallery via scripts/gmaps_photocycle.js. Coffee and breakfast-plate pricing was not visible in any photo, so the site says 'Ask at the counter' instead of inventing a number (variante adaptada, FORGE-BRIEF 0.b).

cakes_by_the_slice: Kiev Cake (price not visible in photo, name only)
services.coffee_and_drinks: Espresso bar with heart-art lattes (seen in gmaps-5.jpg); no price board photographed, site says 'ask at the counter'.
services.breakfast_lunch: Croissant sandwich with smoked salmon, avocado, egg and a side salad (seen in gmaps-6.jpg); no price photographed, site says 'ask at the counter'.

pricing_note: All prices above are read verbatim off real in-store price tags photographed on Google Maps. No price was invented; items without a visible tag (coffee, breakfast plates) are marked 'ask at the counter' per the adapted-variant rule.

reviews_verbatim_google.name: Danielle Christy
reviews_verbatim_google.text: My fiance just was looking for a cute place for a little snack and coffee. We came here and the place was so cute and beautiful inside. They had so many fun pastries as well as a menu for breakfast/lunch.

reviews_verbatim_google.name: Cassandra Ierullo
reviews_verbatim_google.text: Such a cute cafe!! All their pastries and food are delicious from what I tried so far! Really great customer service too. Definitely recommend to stop in! I know I will be back!

reviews_verbatim_google.name: Shady Khechen
reviews_verbatim_google.text: This place has an excellent service, but on top of that, their food is really good. Their crepes, croissants, cakes, and desserts in general are amazing. Try the honey cake!

reviews_verbatim_google.name: Ian Phoenix
reviews_verbatim_google.text: Enchanting little dessert, breakfast and coffee shop with an Eastern European flair! Nice green atmosphere with a bespoke mural and green color palette. And there is a treasure trove of delicious and handcrafted desserts.

reviews_verbatim_google.name: Iryna Miroshnychenko
reviews_verbatim_google.text: Forest Vibe St. Pete is such a small cozy spot and welcoming staff. They have a varied menu for breakfast and a great selection of delicious ...

gallery_curation_note: 9 photos were pulled from the business's Google Maps gallery via gmaps_photocycle.js; all 9 were opened and visually reviewed one by one before selecting. 2 were exact duplicates of the storefront shot (kept only 1). The remaining 7 were all usable real photos of the business (storefront signage, pastry case close-ups with real price tags, cake case, latte art, a breakfast plate, a cake slice, and the interior counter/espresso machine). None were selfies, mid-process shots, or had caption text overlaid; the visible price tags are the business's own real in-store signage, not a social caption. All 7 were used across hero/experience/gallery sections (2 photos reused once each between the About and Gallery sections since there are only 7 total, which is within the design system's allowance when all available photos are genuinely good).
brand_vibe: Light base with a forest/sage green accent (derived from the cafe's real teal-leaf 'Forest Vibe Magical Cafe' signage and from two reviews independently describing a 'green atmosphere' and 'green color palette' mural inside). Palette: accent-deep #3c6b45, accent-mid #7a9b6e, bg #f7f6ef, bg-2 #e7eee0, ink #2a2e22. Chosen deliberately distinct from already-used palettes listed in templates/SKELETONS-V2.md (esmeralda #2f7d5a, teal acero #4fb8b8).
template_base: templates/light-v2 (lashbloom skeleton), derived via the anchored-transformation script method in templates/SKELETONS-V2.md. No HTML was hand-written from scratch; all motion v2/v3 markers, bilingual mechanism and structure were inherited from the skeleton.
adapted_variant_notes: Walk-in cafe, no booking platform. CTAs changed from 'Book on Booksy' to 'Get directions' (Google Maps) and 'Call now' (tel:+17272028614). Instagram sections removed (no verified handle found) and replaced with Hours/Phone cards in Location and Footer. Services grid reframed as a real menu (pastries / cakes by the slice / coffee & drinks / breakfast & lunch) using only verified prices or an honest 'ask at the counter' note.
